description: Mark an email in your agent's inbox as read so it is not handled twice. Use after divimail_read (or divimail_inbox) with the same messageId. Needs a token.

email.description: Your agent's full @divindi.io email address (e.g. myagent@divindi.io)

token.description: JWT token from divimail_login, divimail_authenticate or divimail_service_token

name: divimail_mark_read
